title: Trump decision on Iran deal yet to come as Hegseth talks negotiations
description: President Trump held a meeting with key advisers to hammer out a "final determination" on a potential deal with Iran, but no word has come on a decision.

title: Two women found stabbed to death in Park Slope building that was once scene of 2024 murder suicide
description: Two women were stabbed to death in Park Slope on Saturday night at the same location where a murder-suicide occurred two years ago, according to police.

title: NYC Schools chancellor makes whopping $363K — more than Mayor Mamdani: source
description: New York City Schools Chancellor Kamar Samuels makes a whopping $363,000 a year -- out earning the mayor who hired him by more than $100,000 and making him the city's highest-paid employee, The Post has learned.
